desc: Looking for a new take on an old friend? Introducing the Henry Silver Boy! Built identically to your old favorite the Henry Golden Boy, the Silver Boy features a silver finished receiver and buttplate. This gorgeous lever action rifle is capable of shooting either .22 Short, Long or Long Rifle rimfire ammunition. The 20" beautiful blued barrel sits atop a full length magazine tube. Adjustable Buckhorn rear sights, a bead front sight and a gorgeous American walnut stock round out the top features of this must have rifle.
